title: 第25章 奖励 灵蛇吐纳法第26章 麻烦跌踵
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 林柔刚刚发完那一通火，虽然嘴上骂的是王锦程没出息。
可她的眼神，却总是控制不住往窗外飘。
隐约能看到对面的院子，还亮着昏黄的灯火。
这会儿虽然没动静了。
但在她的脑子里，暧昧的声音就像是扎了根一样，怎么也挥之不去。
仿佛，能看到王大山做的事情一样
林柔冷哼了一声，眼神里满是不爽。
明明不久前还是自己，被那个混蛋肆无忌惮的对待。
还说什么太稀罕她了，离不开她。
怎么一转眼的功夫，就捡来一个逃荒来的野丫头。
王大山那个没良心的，肯定是瞎了眼。
亏得她还想着，以后跟着这个混蛋过日子呢。
还为他所过的话，感动了那么一瞬间。
越想越气，林柔忍不住抽了王锦程一巴掌。
王锦程缩着脖子，本来就被骂得不敢吭声。
这会，更怕了。
但他也觉出点不对劲来，心里犯起了嘀咕
刚才林柔说是出去打水。
怎么回来之后，就像是吃了枪药一样，发这么大的脾气？
而且。
她骂完自己之后，也不看着自己，反而死死盯着大哥的房间看。
那眼神，既像是生气，又像是……嫉妒？
还有红扑扑的脸蛋，明显不像是被冻的。
王锦程张了张嘴，想要问点什么，可话到嘴边，又被他咽了回去。
他是个怂包。
平日里被林柔拿捏得死死的，根本不敢多嘴。
再加上他又是个没主见的。
只能安慰自己。
另一边。
屋内，一切都已经归于平静。
木板床也不再摇晃了。
林翠儿蜷缩在被窝的最里面。
她实在是太累了。
本来身子骨就弱，这一路上又是逃荒又是挨饿的。
刚才那一番折腾，几乎耗尽了她最后一丝力气。
此时她紧闭着双眼，睫毛上还挂着泪珠，脸色虽然依旧有些苍白，但却多了一抹不自然的红晕。
王大山半靠在床头，长长地吐出了一口浊气。
神清气爽。
他伸手拉了拉被角，盖在了林翠儿光洁的肩膀上。
content_en:
Lin Rou had just finished her outburst, even though she was scolding Wang Jincheng for being useless.
But her eyes couldn't help but drift toward the window.
You could vaguely see the yard opposite, with dim lights still on.
Although there was no movement at the moment.
But in her mind, the ambiguous voice seemed to have taken root, and she couldn't get rid of it.
It’s as if you can see what Wang Dashan did
"Hmph."
Lin Rou snorted coldly, her eyes full of displeasure.
It was obvious that not long ago, it was me who was treated unscrupulously by that bastard.
He also said that he cared about her so much that he couldn't live without her.
How come in the blink of an eye, I picked up a wild girl who had escaped from the wilderness.
That heartless Wang Dashan must be blind.
Fortunately, she still thought about living with this bastard from now on.
I was also moved for a moment by what he said.
The more she thought about it, the angrier she became, and Lin Rou couldn't help but slap Wang Jincheng.
"Ah."
Wang Jincheng shrank his neck, having been scolded so much that he didn't dare to say a word.
Now I'm even more scared.
But he also felt something was wrong, and he started to murmur in his heart.
Just now Lin Rou said she was going out to fetch water.
Why did he lose such a temper after coming back, as if he had taken gunpowder?
and.
After she scolded herself, she didn't look at herself. Instead, she stared at her eldest brother's room.
That look looked both angry and...jealous?
There is also a red face, which obviously does not look like it is frozen.
"Rou'er..."
Wang Jincheng opened his mouth, wanting to ask something, but when the words reached his lips, he swallowed them back.
He's a coward.
Normally, she was so manipulated by Lin Rou that she didn't dare to say anything.
In addition, he has no independent opinion.
I can only comfort myself.
…
other side.
Inside the house, everything has returned to calm.
The plank bed no longer shook.
Lin Cui'er curled up in the innermost part of the bed.
She was so tired.
My body was already weak, so I had to flee from famine and starve during this journey.
The struggle just now almost exhausted her last bit of strength.
At this time, she closed her eyes tightly, with tears still hanging on her eyelashes. Although her face was still a little pale, it had an unnatural blush.
Wang Dashan half leaned on the head of the bed and exhaled a long breath.
Feel refreshed.
He reached out and pulled the corners of the quilt, covering Lin Cuier's smooth shoulders.
